description: Two floors up, at the fat part of a bead, fully furnished: everything matched and new, and a bowl of fruit that isn't fruit. The curved glass makes the room a wedge. On the counter, a folded card thanks you for viewing and asks you not to use the taps.

window.description: The whole outer wall, floor to ceiling, bowing out and back. Fourteen storeys of Halcyon Fields below and the Curtain a field away, humming, close enough to see the rain not reaching the ground on the far side of it.
window.name: the curved glazing

name: Quiet Enjoyment — The Show Apartment
